design.calibration: frequency-specific constant-bias diagnostic only, fit on calibration blocks and applied to held-out blocks; no LOS/NLOS scalar in 6A
design.spatial_design: blocked routes and independent sites; no random row split as primary

required_capture: serving cell ID and PCI with deterministic mapping to the planning inventory
raw received power, RSRP, SINR, and RSRQ as separate quantities
LOS/NLOS and outdoor labels with source
neighbor cells and co-channel/resource context for SINR/RSRQ
detection limit and left/right censoring flags
safety: do not collect or redistribute identifiers without consent/legal review
do not infer strongest modeled cell as serving identity
do not convert detection floors into exact values
do not compensate device/antenna effects silently
do not feed results into canonical planning until the 6B gate is independently approved
scope: future Ankara/Türkiye 2.6 GHz and 28 GHz outdoor validation campaign
